gaps: iFood does not publish a stable consumer grocery API for this workflow.
Authenticated site-api requests can be masked or rejected outside the signed-in browser session.
Product availability, delivery fees, ratings, and prices are location- and session-dependent.
Checkout, payment, and order submission are intentionally unsupported.
patterns: Keep cookies, anti-fraud state, CAPTCHA handling, and authentication inside the signed-in browser.
Use deterministic local JSON validation for market coverage, rating thresholds, product availability, and totals.
Separate read-only quotation from cart mutation and require confirmation before the first cart item is added.

novel_features.name: Browser-safe workflow plan
novel_features.description: Emit the complete browser-owned quotation and cart workflow without exporting credentials.
novel_features.rationale: The signed-in browser is the reliable owner of cookies, anti-fraud state, and CAPTCHA interactions.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents get deterministic requirements while credentials remain inside the browser.

novel_features.name: Three-market quotation validator
novel_features.description: Validate complete product observations from at least three markets meeting a configurable rating floor.
novel_features.rationale: Visible browser observations need strict local checks before price comparisons are trusted.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The CLI fails closed on missing, unavailable, unnamed, or unpriced products.

novel_features.name: Confirmation-gated cart plan
novel_features.description: Produce the exact selected merchant, products, quantities, and expected total before any cart interaction.
novel_features.rationale: Cart writes require an explicit boundary between local planning and external mutation.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents can request approval for a concrete plan and stop on substitutions or price changes.

novel_features.name: Cross-market grocery quote
novel_features.description: Compare requested grocery terms across eligible markets and return complete price estimates.
novel_features.rationale: The private API requires composing market discovery and per-merchant product searches.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents can inspect the direct-API composition when a controlled session supports it.

novel_features.name: Preview-first cart builder
novel_features.description: Resolve product terms into an exact read-only cart-item preview.
novel_features.rationale: Product choice and cart mutation remain separate phases; cart add owns the confirmation-gated write.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents can review a complete resolved request before authorizing cart add, while checkout remains unsupported.

narrative.headline: Agent-ready iFood grocery quoting with browser-owned authentication and confirmation-gated cart planning.
narrative.value_prop: This CLI combines typed iFood grocery discovery with a deterministic Browser-backed workflow for comparing a complete shopping list across eligible markets. Authentication and anti-fraud state stay inside the signed-in browser, while the CLI validates observations, totals, and the exact cart plan locally.
narrative.auth_narrative: Prefer the Browser-backed commands, which never export cookies or authorization headers. Direct private-API commands accept IFOOD_BEARER_AUTH only in controlled environments and may still be rejected by iFood anti-automation controls.

quickstart.comment: Generate the safe quotation workflow and default six-item requirements.
Inspect the preview-first direct cart builder without changing a cart.

troubleshoots.symptom: Direct API commands return an HTML 404 or authentication error
troubleshoots.fix: Use the Browser-backed workflow with the existing signed-in iFood session; do not export cookies or anti-fraud values.
Collect complete observations for at least three eligible markets and rerun browser validate-quote before planning the cart.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this skill when an agent needs to quote grocery products on iFood, compare complete market totals, or prepare an exact cart plan while preserving browser authentication boundaries.

recipes.title: Validate a complete quotation
recipes.explanation: Rejects incomplete or below-threshold markets and selects the lowest complete known total.

recipes.title: Prepare a confirmation-ready cart plan
recipes.explanation: Produces an exact local plan and never writes to the remote cart.

recipes.title: Inspect direct cart composition safely
recipes.explanation: Shows preview-first cart composition options without running a mutation.
